system.name: WLB-LLM
system.one_liner: a workload-balanced 4D parallelism scheme for LLM training that combines data, pipeline, context, and tensor parallelism

components.name: DP-0
components.role: one data-parallel worker owning a shard of the global batch and a full pipeline of PP stages

components.name: DP-1
components.role: additional data-parallel worker

components.name: DP-2
components.role: additional data-parallel worker

components.name: DP-3
components.role: additional data-parallel worker

components.name: PP-0
components.role: pipeline stage owning the first chunk of model layers

components.name: PP-1
components.role: pipeline stage owning the next chunk of model layers

components.name: PP-2
components.role: pipeline stage owning the next chunk of model layers

components.name: PP-3
components.role: pipeline stage owning the last chunk of model layers

components.name: Layer 0
components.role: a model layer held on this pipeline stage

components.name: Input Sequence (Packed Documents)
components.role: the packed input sequence split into chunks before context-parallel sharding

components.name: Chunk 0
components.role: one chunk of the packed input sequence

components.name: Chunk 1
components.role: another chunk of the packed input sequence

components.name: CP-0
components.role: context-parallel worker holding a shard of the sequence-length dimension

components.name: CP-1
components.role: another context-parallel worker holding a shard of the sequence-length dimension

components.name: TP-0
components.role: tensor-parallel worker holding a shard of the layer's parameters

components.name: TP-1
components.role: another tensor-parallel worker holding a shard of the layer's parameters

components.name: AllGather / ReduceScatter
components.role: collective communication that gathers KV tensors across CP workers in the forward pass and reduce-scatters gradients in backward

components.name: Attention
components.role: attention sublayer operating on the sharded/gathered sequence

components.name: Layer Norm
components.role: normalization sublayer run independently per worker

components.name: MLP
components.role: feed-forward sublayer run independently per worker

content.key_idea: 4D parallelism composes data, pipeline, context, and tensor parallelism hierarchically: DP workers each hold a pipeline of layer chunks, and within a layer, context-parallel groups shard the sequence while tensor-parallel groups within each CP shard the layer's parameters, synchronized via AllGather/ReduceScatter.
content.reading_order: Left panel first, top-down through nested DP/PP/Layer boxes; a dashed callout zooms into one pipeline stage's layers to the right panel, read left-to-right and top-down through Chunk/CP/TP boxes and the two stacked Attention-LayerNorm-MLP sublayers.

evidence: Figure 2 presents an example of a (TP=2, CP=2, PP=4, DP=4) 4D parallelism
CP duplicates the model parameters but shards the input and activations along the sequence length
TP splits the model parameters within a layer

summary: This figure illustrates an example instantiation of 4D parallelism (TP=2, CP=2, PP=4, DP=4) as used in LLM training. The left panel shows four data-parallel workers (DP-0 to DP-3), each internally split into four pipeline stages (PP-0 to PP-3) that own consecutive pairs of model layers (Layer 0 through Layer 7). A dashed callout zooms from one pipeline stage into the right panel, which shows how an input sequence of packed documents is chunked and sharded across two context-parallel groups (CP-0, CP-1), each further split into two tensor-parallel workers (TP-0, TP-1). Within each CP group, an AllGather/ReduceScatter collective synchronizes KV tensors before two stacked Attention-LayerNorm-MLP sublayers process the data. The diagram uses nested navy/blue/green/yellow boxes to convey the composition of data, pipeline, context, and tensor parallelism from outermost to innermost.
summary_zh: 该图展示了 4D 并行（TP=2, CP=2, PP=4, DP=4）的一个实例：左侧为数据并行与流水线并行的嵌套结构（DP-x 内含 PP-x 与层），右侧放大展示单层内上下文并行与张量并行如何通过 AllGather/ReduceScatter 及 Attention-LayerNorm-MLP 子层协作。
